title: Legaltech news reports on Burford's AI and legal tech webinar
summary: In an article entitled "4 Considerations When Buying or Building Legal Technology," Legaltech news reports on Burford's recent webinar about unlocking generative AI in legal technology, moderated by Vice Chair David Perla. The article touches on major themes of the webinar, such as the evolution of legal roles given the rise of AI and whether to build or buy legal tech software.
body_markdown:
In an article entitled "4 Considerations When Buying or Building Legal Technology," Legaltech news reports on Burford's recent webinar about unlocking generative AI in legal technology, moderated by Vice Chair[David Perla](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/david-perla/) . The article touches on major themes of the webinar, such as the evolution of legal roles given the rise of AI and whether to build or buy legal tech software.


[Click here to read the full article.](https://www.law.com/legaltechnews/2024/09/24/4-considerations-when-buying-or-building-legal-technology/)
